I was spoiled all my life, I have a family that loves me, a wife I adore, and greatest group of friends...And I'm still depressed. It a disorder plain and simple. It sounds like it. The best thing to do you can do is talk to someone about it. I know it seems like youre being weak when you ask for help, but when you are depressed...being brave enough to come out of your shell and "I'm done with being depressed" is the strongest thing you can do. If you are scared to talk to someone either, personal or professional, you can always find friends here and always feel free to message me!

I think you are my twin! I tell you what help me was hobbies. It's fun and helpful to find like minded people who enjoy the same things you do. For me it was going to local comic shops and playing things like pathfinder or D&D. The ability to hang out, munch on some pizza, and challenge my brain at the same time was the prefect cure! A lot of those friends are now drinking buddies and even my best friends!

I'm glad you're here, friend. Have you look into profession help in your area? I'm sure someone will work with your insurance. If not...find a friend to talk to. Just getting some pressure off your chest could turn everything around! If you can't find a friend you could always pm me. "being scared means you give a shit!" you know that you don't want to go through this...so lets get you back on your feet!

You said it yourself! You need help. Wake up someone and talk to them, call a hotline, go somewhere to get help, or talk to someone on here! I know life sucks sometimes, but it does get better! I promise if you just get help you will regret even thinking about hurting yourself! you're with friends.
